newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares dip as players take profits.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares dip as players take profits.

text.p: Profit-taking in Hansapank and Hoiupank brought the Tallinn bourse down on Monday after the market had rallied to record highs last week.
The Talse index slipped 1.01 percent to 302.43 and total trade reached 97.6 million kroons.
Hansapank fell 2.35 kroons to 168.90 and Hoiupank lost 2.6 kroons to 169.90 in active trade.
"It is logical, rational behaviour as investors gained lots of money during the last few days," a dealer said.
Both shares rose over 10 percent last week on the strength of their six-month results.
Drug firm Farmaatsiatehas was also active, trading 4.94 million kroons to gain 1.35 kroons to 124.60.
On the free market, Norma was most active stock in trade of 9.6 million kroons to be 0.35 kroons lower at 79.65.
Rakvere meat factory traded five million kroons to gain 0.44 kroons to 14.10.
The three companies are due to announce their half-year results soon.
